_note: Batch 20: 21 REAL Perth practices researched from public information on 11 Aug 2026, spread across ten categories. This is a partial delivery against a request for 50 — every entry was verified on the business's own website (name, suburb, services, credentials, contact, and prices where published), and the batch stopped where honest verification stopped rather than being padded out. Deduped against all 232 businesses already live or sitting in batch files 2–19; four candidates that reached final draft (Claudia Richards Art Therapy, Mindful in Nature, The Gentle Village, Before & After Baby) were caught by that check as already listed and removed. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. TGA discipline matters especially here: the naturopathy, nutrition and creative-therapy entries all publish long condition lists (PCOS, endometriosis, anxiety, IBS, eczema, trauma) and NONE of it is repeated — copy names services, credentials, formats and fees only. Also rejected in verification: The HeARTwork Centre (Albany, 400km away), Nest Yoga (no verifiable detail), Reiki Energy Perth (domain unreachable), Nutrition Nation and Perth Meditation Centre (already listed). New suburbs: Victoria Park, Woodlands.

categories.name: Meditation classes

listings.name: Charleyoga
listings.blurb: Charley has taught for over two decades from shared studio spaces in Applecross, Bateman and Hilton, with a practice built deliberately for stiff mornings and old injuries rather than for people who already bend easily. Gentle therapeutic yoga, strength work, mindfulness and meditation, plus private yoga-therapy sessions, seniors classes and online options. Registered as a Yoga Therapist with both Yoga Australia and IAYT, and a Level 3 teacher.
listings._source: charleyoga.com.au — teacher, three studio suburbs, two decades teaching, Yoga Australia and IAYT registrations, service list, phone and email all published; prices on their own timetable page

listings.name: Yoga Corner
listings.blurb: A first-floor studio at Carine Central covering the full spread — vinyasa and ashtanga through to yin, restorative, pre- and post-natal, and classes for kids and teens. Built around the same three words on every page: breathe, move, meditate.
listings._source: yogacornerperth.com — Davallia Road address, class styles, phone, email and Punchpass booking published; prices on a separate page

listings.name: Element Pilates
listings.address: Unit 1, 484 Albany Highway, Victoria Park WA
listings.blurb: A reformer studio on the Albany Highway strip running four class types, from a foundational Classic through to a cardio-leaning Sweat and Burn, plus a twelve-week Mums and Bubs postnatal program. Fourteen days unlimited for $69 gets newcomers through the door.
listings._source: elementpilates.com.au — Albany Highway address, four class formats, $69/14-day intro, phone published; email obfuscated on the page

listings.name: Best Body Bassendean
listings.address: Shop 17, Bassendean Shopping Centre, Cnr West & Old Perth Road, Bassendean WA 6054
listings.blurb: Therapeutic reformer Pilates in the Bassendean shopping centre, with an unusually transparent price list — casual classes at $45, weekly memberships from $48 for two classes up to $80 for four, and a six-week money-back guarantee. Open from 6am on weekdays with on-site parking.
listings._source: bestbody.com.au — full address, complete published price list, hours, money-back guarantee and phone confirmed

listings.name: Heartbeat High
listings.blurb: Four studios across the western suburbs and the city — Shenton Park, Cottesloe, White Gum Valley and Barrack Street — running reformer and floor Pilates across eight class styles, with over two hundred classes a week between them and one membership covering the lot. The intro is four weeks unlimited for $190.
services: Cottesloe, White Gum Valley & city studios
listings._source: heartbeathigh.com.au — all four addresses, class styles, 200+ weekly classes, $190/4-week intro published; contact via their app and site form

listings.name: Move Physiotherapy
listings.blurb: Physiotherapy and exercise rehabilitation across Booragoon, Beeliar and East Fremantle, led by Daniel Ryan with a Masters of Physiotherapy from the University of South Australia. Remedial massage runs alongside, and initial consults include complimentary VALD strength testing — objective numbers rather than a guess at where you are. Open from 6:30am and Saturday mornings.
listings._source: movephysiotherapy.com.au — all locations, lead physiotherapist and qualification, service list, early and Saturday hours, phone and online booking published

listings.name: Foot Ankle & Lower Limb
listings.blurb: A Booragoon podiatry clinic running since 1981 with eight podiatrists on staff, including a podiatric surgeon. Orthotic therapy, nail surgery, shockwave and laser therapy, ultrasound-guided injections and sports work, weekdays 8am to 6pm with Saturdays by appointment.
listings._source: footanklelowerlimb.com.au — Coomoora Road address, since-1981 history, all eight practitioners named, service list, hours, phone and email published

listings.name: Star Physio
listings.blurb: Twenty-five years of physiotherapy from West Perth and Mosman Park, with podiatry and a sports dietitian under the same roof — and a physiotherapist-led bike fitting service using saddle pressure mapping, which is a rarer thing to find in a clinic than in a bike shop.
listings._source: starphysiowa.com.au — both clinics with phones, 25+ years, service list including BikeFit, online booking published; prices not listed

listings.name: Revive Physiotherapy
listings.blurb: One of the widest physiotherapy footprints in the state — Joondalup, Midland, Booragoon, Rockingham, Mandurah, Armadale, Riverton, Cockburn, Beechboro and Mount Claremont among them — with exercise physiology, hydrotherapy, pregnancy and children's physiotherapy alongside the standard work. Takes DVA, WorkCover, NDIS and Medicare referrals.
listings._source: revivephysiowa.com.au — full WA location list, services, funding streams, phone and email published. Their eastern-states clinics are outside our scope and not mentioned

listings.name: WA Health Group
listings.blurb: A multidisciplinary group running clinics at Bicton, Burswood, Canning Vale and Murdoch, with physiotherapy, exercise physiology, chiropractic, podiatry, dietetics, occupational therapy and remedial massage under one banner — plus a dedicated clinical Pilates studio at Bicton and home-care services for those who can't travel.
listings._source: wahealthgroup.com.au — all four clinic locations with individual phone numbers, full service list, Peak Pilates studio confirmed

listings.name: Your Local Healing Choice
listings.blurb: A small network of remedial rooms across Wembley, Subiaco and Nedlands, built around assessment-led treatment rather than a fixed rub-down — remedial and sports massage, pregnancy massage, manual lymphatic drainage, with dry needling and myofascial cupping where the practitioner judges them suitable. Each clinic books separately through Fresha.
listings._source: yourlocalhealingchoice.com/clinics — three clinics with individual phone numbers, service list, Fresha booking published; prices not listed

listings.name: Golden Threads Art Therapy
listings.blurb: Paige McNaught works across an unusually wide set of materials — visual art, clay, sand play, photography, textiles, movement and music among them — from Fremantle and Perth, or online Australia-wide. A PACFA-registered counsellor and ANZACATA member with a psychotherapy degree behind the arts training. Individual sessions are published at $156.16 an hour, with NDIS creative counselling groups alongside.
listings._source: goldenthreadsarttherapy.com — practitioner, credentials (PACFA, ANZACATA, CCET), materials and formats, published hourly fee, phone and email confirmed

listings.name: ART IN PROCESS
listings.blurb: Elisabeth Eitelberger practises as both a psychodynamic psychotherapist and a creative arts therapist in Walyalup/Fremantle, with a Vienna philosophy and theatre background behind a Murdoch creative arts therapies masters. Clinically registered with PACFA and ANZACATA. Sixty-minute sessions at $190, with concession and block rates, in person or online. Adults and couples.
listings._source: artinprocess.com/therapy — practitioner, both registration numbers (PACFA 31237, ANZACATA 48216287), qualifications, $190 session fee with concession rates, email published

listings.name: Perth Doula Services
listings.blurb: Michelle McKechnie works as a birth and postpartum doula across Perth, certified as an advanced birth and postpartum doula and separately trained in hypnobirthing, breastfeeding fundamentals, Spinning Babies, and massage and acupressure. Support runs from prenatal visits and birth planning through labour and into the weeks afterwards.
listings._source: perthdoulaservices.com.au — doula name, full certification list, service scope and phone published; prices not listed

listings.name: Soulworks Therapies
listings.blurb: Miranda Diprose combines reiki with seventeen years of clinical hypnotherapy from Woodlands, holding Clinical and Fellow membership of the Australian Hypnotherapists Association and having served on its board. Counselling, NLP and EFT sit alongside, in person or online.
listings._source: soulworkstherapies.com — practitioner, Woodlands location, AHA Clinical and Fellow membership with board service, 17 years, service list, phone and online booking published

listings.name: Perth Health Collective
listings.blurb: Four clinical nutritionists on Beaufort Street, all degree-qualified in health science, working face to face in Mount Lawley or online Australia-wide. Functional testing backs the consultations, and the practice states a health-at-every-size approach openly — a position worth knowing before you book either way.
listings._source: perthhealthcollective.com.au — Beaufort Street address, all four practitioners named with BHSc qualifications, consultation formats, stated philosophy, phone and email published. Their clinical focus list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: The Naturopath's Corner
listings.blurb: Manon Bocquet founded this Scarborough practice after ten years in clinic, now joined by Victoria de Robillard — both degree-qualified from Endeavour College as naturopaths, herbalists and clinical nutritionists, and both ANTA members. Consultations run face to face or online Australia-wide, and between them they consult in English, French and German.
listings._source: thenaturopathscorner.com.au/pages/about — both practitioners, Endeavour degrees, ANTA membership, languages and booking platform published; prices and phone not listed. Their condition specialties deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Subiaco Naturopath Clinic
listings.blurb: Fifty years in business on Rokeby Road, operating inside the Pharmacy777 and open seven days — which almost nothing else in this category manages. Five naturopaths on staff between them carrying over a century of practice, with a compounding pharmacy and a range of diagnostic testing on site.
listings._source: subiaconaturopathclinic.com — Rokeby Road address, 50+ years, all five practitioners named with years of experience, seven-day hours, phone and email published. Their condition list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Floralia Wellness
listings.blurb: A ten-practitioner integrative clinic under clinical director Angela Hywood, combining naturopathy, acupuncture and Chinese medicine, functional medicine and clinical nutrition in one practice — with advanced testing from hormone panels to gut microbiome behind the consultations. Initial appointments run a full hour, with telehealth across WA and nationally.
listings._source: floraliawellness.com.au — clinical director and full practitioner list, modalities, testing menu, 60-minute initial consults, phone and email published; street address not shown. Their specialisation list deliberately not repeated

listings.name: ELD Naturopathy
listings.blurb: Elle-Lou Diddams consults from Leederville on Mondays and Thursdays and online the rest of the week, with a health science degree in naturopathy and ANTA registration. One of the few in this category to publish a full fee schedule: a free discovery call, $250 for the 75-minute initial, $130–$165 for follow-ups and $100 for a short acute appointment.
listings._source: eldnaturopathy.com — practitioner, degree and ANTA registration, Leederville consulting days, complete published fee schedule, phone and email confirmed. Her condition focus areas deliberately not repeated

listings.name: Perth Meditation Courses & Coaching
listings.blurb: Kevin teaches meditation from Aberdeen Street in Northbridge as a structured progression rather than drop-in sittings — three six-session courses running from a first introduction through to advanced practice, each with weekly materials and guided audio to take away.
listings._source: perthmeditation.com.au — Aberdeen Street address, teacher, three-course structure, phone and email published. Distinct from Perth Meditation Centre (Subiaco) and Perth Meditation (Bicton), both already listed — different businesses with confusingly similar names
